name: Blind Melon Chitlin

tenures.role: wrestler -- held the World Heavyweight, Intercontinental and Six-Man Tag titles at once in 1996
tenures.source: the fed's own issue (VCW Online #8, 24 April 1995) and the community's own Hall of Fame nomination threads of 22 September and 22 November 1997, which credit his 1996 title run and his own booking company, BMC Enterprises

caption: Held the VCW World Heavyweight, Intercontinental and Six-Man Tag titles all at once in 1996, credited by the community as the promotion's own defining monster heel.

name: Johnny Dominant

tenures.source: the community's own RSPWF Top 75 rankings of 19 October 1995 (ranked #14) and the community's own Hall of Fame nomination threads of 22 September and 22 November 1997, which credit him as VCW's own Light Heavyweight Champion

caption: Ranked #14 in the community's own RSPWF Top 75 of 1995 and credited there as VCW's own Light Heavyweight Champion.

identity.note: Exact name collision against the newsgroup's own 1997 mention of a "Johnny Dominant," named only in passing there as a VCW-era wrestling character in the 30 June 1996 and 12 February 1997 Hall of Fame induction classes, with no VCW-specific record held for it. This record cites separate, later 1997 nomination threads (22 September and 22 November) for the same name; the two may describe the same in-fiction character or two distinct nominees sharing a name, and no document ties the two together explicitly. Filed distinct on the conservative reading.

name: Purple Haze

tenures.source: VCW Online #69 (26 August 1996) and VCW Online #70, 'Fall From Grace' (5 September 1996), both reprinted whole inside another federation's own 2 November 1996 post

caption: VCW's own reigning World Heavyweight Champion, defending the Nine Worthies Cup billing against a touring legend before falling to interference on 5 September 1996.

identity.note: An exact bare-name collision against another, unrelated wing's own 'Purple Haze' (a masked wrestler active 2001-2005 at a different federation, five years later); no shared operator, roster, host or era links the two. Filed distinct.

caption: Billed as VCW's own three-time former World Heavyweight Champion, eliminated from the Nine Worthies Cup by a touring rival's Tiger's Pounce.
